name: ERP-lite (stock, purchase, sales)
description: For a small trading or manufacturing business: items (the Products of the common business model), locations, stock movements with stock on hand that never goes below zero (checked in the same transaction as each movement), purchase requests with approval, purchase orders with approval above a limit, goods receipts in parts, sales orders priced from the price list, deliveries with a delivery challan, and commercial invoices WITHOUT tax (not tax invoices: no GST is computed, stored or printed). Desktop apps for purchase, stores and sales, a phone app for the stores (scan, receive, issue, count, offline), two dashboards, five print templates, ten flows, six roles, number sequences per financial year, movement reasons as reference rows; SAMPLE rows of a fictional company are optional.

create.name: StockMovements
create.description: Every change of stock: receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments and counts, with a signed quantity (in > 0, out < 0). The stock balance follows each movement in the same transaction; an issue that would take stock below zero is refused.

events.name: A count becomes the difference to the stock
events.actions: If(New.Slot_StockMovements_Kind = "Count", SetField({Slot_StockMovements_Quantity: Coalesce(New.Slot_StockMovements_Counted, 0) - Coalesce(LookUp(Slot_StockBalances, Slot_StockBalances_Item = New.Slot_StockMovements_Item && Slot_StockBalances_Location = New.Slot_StockMovements_Location).Slot_StockBalances_OnHand, 0)}))

events.name: Sign, time, price and links
events.actions: If((New.Slot_StockMovements_Kind = "Issue" || New.Slot_StockMovements_Kind = "Transfer out") && New.Slot_StockMovements_Quantity > 0, SetField({Slot_StockMovements_Quantity: -New.Slot_StockMovements_Quantity})); If(IsBlank(New.Slot_StockMovements_MovedOn), SetField({Slot_StockMovements_MovedOn: Now()})); If(IsBlank(New.Slot_StockMovements_MovedBy) && !IsBlank(User().Id), SetField({Slot_StockMovements_MovedBy: User().Id})); If(IsBlank(New.Slot_StockMovements_UnitPrice), SetField({Slot_StockMovements_UnitPrice: LookUp(Slot_Products, id = New.Slot_StockMovements_Item).Slot_Products_StandardPrice})); If(!IsBlank(New.Slot_StockMovements_PurchaseOrderLine), SetField({Slot_StockMovements_PurchaseOrder: LookUp(Slot_PurchaseOrderLines, id = New.Slot_StockMovements_PurchaseOrderLine).Slot_PurchaseOrderLines_Order})); If(!IsBlank(New.Slot_StockMovements_SalesOrderLine), SetField({Slot_StockMovements_SalesOrder: LookUp(Slot_SalesOrderLines, id = New.Slot_StockMovements_SalesOrderLine).Slot_SalesOrderLines_Order})); If(IsBlank(New.Slot_StockMovements_Reference), SetField({Slot_StockMovements_Reference: New.Slot_StockMovements_Kind}))

events.name: In is above zero, out below zero
events.condition: If(Slot_StockMovements_Kind = "Receipt" || Slot_StockMovements_Kind = "Transfer in", Slot_StockMovements_Quantity > 0, Slot_StockMovements_Kind = "Issue" || Slot_StockMovements_Kind = "Transfer out", Slot_StockMovements_Quantity < 0, Slot_StockMovements_Kind = "Adjustment", Slot_StockMovements_Quantity <> 0, true)
events.message: Type the quantity that moved: receipts and transfers in add stock, issues and transfers out take it (the sign follows the kind), an adjustment is not zero.

flows.name: Purchase request approval
flows.description: A purchase request sent for approval asks a manager on behalf of the person who raised it; the answer and comment are written back.

flows.name: Turn an approved request into a purchase order
flows.description: An approved purchase request becomes a draft purchase order to its preferred supplier with the same lines; the request is marked Ordered.

flows.name: Purchase order approval above Rs 50,000
flows.description: A purchase order sent for approval is approved at once up to Rs 50,000; above that a manager decides. Amounts are before tax (the pack computes no tax).

flows.name: Purchase order receipt status
flows.description: After a goods receipt line, the purchase order becomes Partly received or Received.

flows.name: Sales order delivery status
flows.description: After a delivery line, the sales order becomes Partly delivered or Delivered.

flows.name: Complete a transfer
flows.description: A transfer out of one location is booked in at the location it goes to (the stock is checked where it leaves).

flows.name: Reorder alert
flows.description: When the stock of an item at a location falls below its reorder level, the Purchase role is told.

steps.name: TellPurchase
steps.title: "Reorder: " & Steps.Item.Output.Slot_Products_Name & " at " & Steps.Location.Output.Slot_Locations_Code
steps.body: "On hand " & Text(Trigger.Record.Slot_StockBalances_OnHand) & ", reorder level " & Text(Trigger.Record.Slot_StockBalances_ReorderLevel) & ". Raise a purchase request or order."

flows.name: Delivery notification
flows.description: A delivery marked Dispatched tells the person who owns the sales order.

flows.name: Commercial invoice for a delivery
flows.description: A delivery marked Delivered gets a draft commercial invoice with its lines at the sales order prices (no tax is computed); it belongs to the owner of the sales order.

flows.name: Overdue purchase order reminder
flows.description: Every working day at 09:30 (India time) the Purchase role is told about orders past their expected date that are not fully received.

roles.name: Requester
roles.description: Asks for things to be bought: their own purchase requests only; reads the stock.

roles.name: Purchase
roles.description: Buys: every purchase request, purchase orders and their lines, suppliers and price lists; reads receipts and stock.

roles.name: Stores
roles.description: Keeps the stock: receipts against approved orders, issues, deliveries, transfers, counts, locations and reorder levels; sees order quantities but not purchase rates.

roles.name: Sales
roles.description: Sells: their own sales orders and invoices; reads deliveries and the stock.

roles.name: Accounts (read)
roles.description: Reads orders, receipts, deliveries, invoices and stock; changes nothing.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Approves purchase requests and purchase orders above the limit; sees and changes everything of the pack.
